brand.notes: No logo, colours or fonts supplied (onboarding form says 'I need one designed'). This copy of the site is restyled after lemondropaccounting.com at the operator's request: navy #13203A for type, the Contact us button and dark bands; lemon #F5D547 as a fill only (buttons on navy, icon discs, highlights; it fails contrast as text on white); blush #FBEAE6 tinted bands and #F3C6BE behind the hero photo; pale lemon #FFF6D2 bands; green #127548 for call buttons; zest #B23C0A for small accent labels (6.0:1 on white); light grey #EDECEA footer. Stand-in mark: a lemon disc with a navy 'M', until a real logo is designed.
